decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down with a hydraulic failure. Radio and CMMS agree, so the CONFIRM-01 rule does not apply. Repair is likely 13:30 (range 12:30-14:30). TJ-E595-06 holds 256 t at 15.4 gpt, about 14.9 oz/h with an LH410 at 30 t/h. Este trucks have room: inflow is 36 t/h against 72 t/h of truck capacity, and the stockpile is 171 of 450 t. The cheapest lender is LH-08, from the preparation heading DS-C512-01. It costs 1.9 oz/h and arrives in 0.53 h. LH-09 would cost 4.0 oz/h on the critical-path heading, and LH-07 would drop a producing Norte stope. Estimate: about 6.5 loading hours gives about 195 t, or about 96 oz. Subtract about 13 oz of heading loss, for a net of about 75-80 oz.

Keep LH-08 at E595-06 (15.4 g/t, high value, Este not truck-limited). Don't cover C590-05: Central is truck-limited (inflow 118 vs 91 t/h, stockpile 278/450). Remaining Central ore of about 829 t without C590 already fills truck capacity plus stockpile room (about 836 t), so another loader adds almost nothing. Pulling a loader from development would cost 1.9 to 4.0 oz/h. LH-10 returns at 11:00, and the same logic applies to it.

Keep LH-08 at E595-06 (about 14.9 oz/h, 15.4 g/t, 244 t, Este trucks have headroom); its home heading is only worth 1.9 oz/h. LH-09 to E569-08 (0.37 h away): about 6.9 oz/h against 4.0 oz/h lost on the critical heading, net +2.9 oz/h over about 6 h. LH-10 comes out of PM at 11:00 and goes to C590-05 (0.33 h from the workshop), at no cost to any producing place: about 160 t, roughly 38 oz. No reserves are activated because no stope was stopped. Radio and CMMS agree on all three failures, so no confirmations are needed.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
